summary.text: Bryan Simonaire is a Republican member of the Maryland Senate for District 31 in Anne Arundel County, first elected in 2006 and a senator since 2007. His official page lists him on the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment and says he was Minority Leader from 2020 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Simonaire's official page says he was born in Baltimore in 1963 and lists a B.S. in computer science from Bob Jones University in 1985 and an M.S. in engineering science from Loyola College in 2005.
It says he was a computer systems engineer at Westinghouse from 1985 to 1994 and has been a senior engineer at Northrop Grumman since 1995, and that he founded Heroes-at-Home in 2002.
It lists him as married with seven children.
The page lists his Senate service on the Education, Health, and Environmental Affairs Committee from 2011 to 2023, including as Chair of its Alcohol Subcommittee from 2019 to 2023.
It lists Legislator of the Year honors from the Maryland Military Coalition in 2025 and 2021 and from the American Legion Department of Maryland in 2024 and 2019.
